description: This file is a code-behind class for an ASP.NET WebForms page that manages editing course theory information. It includes event handlers for page load, button clicks, and dropdown list selection changes, primarily facilitating navigation between pages and updating course selections based on semester choices.

classes.name: EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for managing the web page for editing theory courses, handling navigation and course selection based on semester.
